title: BijiSatu configuration
description: Optional settings for the MT5 runtime. Missing fields use the displayed defaults. Changing this file does not update an already running process; restart the robot to load changes.

strategy_mode.description: Selects closed-candle EMA trend/pullback trading: scalping uses M1 entries and M5 trend; intraday uses M15 entries and H1 trend. ATR14 is measured on the entry timeframe. Intraday is a hypothesis to test, not a guarantee of daily profit or a same-day exit. Changing modes does not clear saved daily halts or attempts.

max_open_risk_fraction.description: Combined planned open-position risk ceiling as a fraction of CURRENT equity: 0.05 = 5%. Reserves loss from current bid/ask marks to server stops plus estimated round-trip commission and risk_buffer. Each candidate is capped by the smaller of unused open-risk capacity and remaining daily budget. It does not close or modify existing positions if falling equity exceeds the ceiling, and gaps can exceed planned risk.

risk_fraction.description: Maximum planned risk per new entry as a fraction of current account equity: 0.03 = 3%, not 0.03 lots. Cannot exceed daily_loss_fraction. Remaining daily budget and open-position risk may reduce the volume or prevent entry. Gaps and slippage can exceed planned risk.

daily_loss_fraction.description: Daily equity-loss threshold as a fraction of the day's saved baseline: 0.05 = 5%. Includes realized and floating account PnL. Reaching it blocks new entries until the next broker day, even if equity recovers. Existing positions are not forcibly closed; actual loss can exceed this threshold.

max_positions.description: Maximum simultaneous open positions allowed before new entries are blocked, with an absolute cap of 10. The robot also allows only one position per symbol. This is an upper limit, not a target; account-wide risk limits still apply. Foreign/manual positions block entries separately.

max_symbols.description: Maximum symbols in the scan list, whether discovered automatically or supplied in symbols. An explicit list is deduplicated in order and truncated to this limit. Scanning a symbol does not guarantee a trade.

poll_seconds.description: Seconds to sleep after each completed scan. Actual time between scans also includes processing time. This is not a trade frequency or chart timeframe; signals use the closed entry/trend candles selected by strategy_mode.

cooldown_seconds.description: Minimum time between entry attempts for the same symbol: 300 seconds = 5 minutes. The attempt is saved before sending an order, so dry-run plans and rejected or uncertain sends can also start the cooldown. It is not the holding time of a position.

max_tick_age_seconds.description: Maximum accepted age of a bid/ask quote relative to the current UTC clock, in seconds. Older quotes are skipped. Future timestamps are rejected independently; increasing this value does not make an inactive feed fresh.

max_spread_atr.description: Maximum spread divided by entry-timeframe ATR14 (M1 scalping, M15 intraday). 0.15 means spread must be at most 15% of ATR, NOT 0.15 pips. Example: spread 0.8 pip / ATR 1.6 pips = 0.50, so a 0.15 limit rejects entry. Raising this value admits more expensive setups relative to volatility and should be tested offline first.

stop_atr.description: Initial stop-loss distance multiplier applied to entry-timeframe ATR14 (M1 scalping, M15 intraday): 1.5 means 1.5 times ATR. Spread, broker minimum stop distance and tick-size rounding can widen the actual stop. Lot sizing uses the resulting stop distance.

reward_ratio.description: Take-profit distance divided by the actual entry-to-stop distance, before costs: 1.5 targets a price move 1.5 times the stop distance. This is not a win-rate estimate or a guaranteed net return. Tick-size rounding can change the exact ratio.

risk_buffer.description: Multiplier applied to estimated stop-loss risk and commission for conservative sizing and open-risk reservations. 1.15 adds a 15% cushion; 1 adds none. A larger buffer normally reduces lot size. It does not guarantee protection from gaps or extreme slippage.

max_margin_fraction.description: Maximum fraction of currently available free margin that a proposed order may require: 0.8 = 80%. An order above the cap is rejected rather than automatically resized by this check. This is a margin safeguard, not permission to risk 80% of equity.

deviation_points.description: Allowed entry-price deviation in broker points, not pips. On five-decimal EURUSD, 10 points = 1 pip. Used for the pre-send price check, order request and conservative loss estimate. Broker execution rules can differ; it is not a guaranteed slippage cap.

magic.description: Positive integer identifying this robot's orders and positions. Keep it stable while positions are open; otherwise existing positions can be treated as foreign and block entries. Do not reuse it for unrelated strategies on the same account.

symbols.description: Exact broker symbol names to scan, for example EURUSDc and GBPUSDc where those names exist. An empty list enables metadata-based discovery, capped by max_symbols. An explicit list is preferable when testing selected instruments. Multiple symbols can share correlated risk.

account_login.description: MT5 trading-account login number used to reject connection to an unintended account. It is not an email or password. null leaves observation unlocked and is forbidden for --execute. Store the real number only in ignored local configuration.

broker_utc_offset_hours.description: Broker server's offset from UTC, in hours, used for daily risk resets: 0 = UTC, 2 = UTC+2, -3.5 = UTC-3:30. Verify with the broker and account for DST changes. null uses UTC with a warning in observation and is forbidden for execution. Market-session labels have their own timezone rules.

commission_per_lot.description: Estimated round-trip opening PLUS closing commission for one lot, in account-currency units. 0 explicitly assumes no commission; it does not mean zero spread or swap. On a USC account use cents, not dollar amounts. null is treated as zero in observation sizing but blocks execution. Use a conservative estimate if selected symbols have different fees.

terminal_path.description: Optional path to the intended MT5 terminal executable, useful when multiple terminals are installed. Escape Windows backslashes in JSON, for example C:\Program Files\Broker MT5\terminal64.exe becomes C:\\Program Files\\Broker MT5\\terminal64.exe in the JSON string. null uses the MT5 package's default terminal discovery.

state_dir.description: Directory holding durable daily baselines, halted-day flags and entry-attempt history, separated by account and mode. Relative paths use the process working directory; the launcher sets it to the project root. Do not delete, move or edit state to bypass limits. Exclude any custom location from Git.

log_dir.description: Base directory for daily JSONL records, written under bijisatu/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl using UTC dates. Includes DEBUG details even without --verbose. Files are appended and are not deleted automatically. Relative paths use the working directory. Exclude custom locations from Git and monitor disk usage.

heartbeat_seconds.description: Interval for repeating an unchanged runtime status in the terminal, checked after each scan. 60 means roughly once per minute; a slow scan can delay it. Status changes are reported earlier. This does not change scan frequency, signal rules or trade frequency.
